opening.argument: The video directs viewers to join Bitconnect through a referral URL while presenting it as a passive-income opportunity. The description calls it “the passive income machine” and provides a link to join, connecting the promised financial benefit to a requested action. The speaker further claims that platforms pay him for temporarily placing money with them and says the choices in the description are “paying me for holding my money.” He also refers to being paid 1% a day for holding funds. These claims promote returns tied to placing money, although the exact transaction terms and any payment outcome remain unclear.
